positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer for leader in cyber security software (Data Loss Prevention)
• Programs primarily in enterprise Java; uses Perforce for version control
• Lead developer on new product development, from proof of concept to release     
• Handles business critical customer escalations involving potential data loss for financial
  services, health care, and governmental agencies 
• Fixes bugs and creates hot-fixes for the Discover product and Enforce product
• Collaborates with QA, Customer Support, Build, and Product Development teams to improve   
   software and create new features
• Creates tools to build and deploy debug jars to remote VM’s using python
• Works with distributed scrum teams in India and San Francisco as lead developer
• Works on web front end using J2EE, Oracle, Spring, JPA, Hibernate, Javascript, and HTML
• Familiarity with Azure Identity Management, ADFS, Office 365, Office 365 REST API, multi-
  tenant/single-tenant Azure apps, and OAuth 2.0 authentication protocols
• Consistently increases knowledge of cyber security principles while working on customer  
  escalations and new feature development

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer for leader in Industrial Automation software.
	• Created new data visualization components to display data from relational databases
	• Programmed in Java, Python, SQL, Javascript, and HTML/CSS
	• Programmed in Java on server side, client side, and worked on stand-alone applications
	• Worked on small team (5 developers) in a startup atmosphere using version control
	• Extensively worked with the Java Swing GUI toolkit to program the front end GUI
	• Worked with relational databases using SQL and Java
	• Designed software elements using object oriented and J2EE design patterns
